tweets.text_resolved: Statement from @SecMayorkas on President Biden’s Executive Order on Screening Inbound Foreign Investments. https://t.co/syqq7xQzA0

media.alt_text:
Secretary’s Statement:

President Biden’s directive will better enable DHS and our partner agencies to protect against foreign threats to our national security – including the ever-evolving threats to our technological sector and our critical infrastructure.  

The Executive Order explicitly addresses and responds to the ways in which certain foreign adversaries invest in the Unites States in order to obtain access to sensitive data and technologies. It will ensure that the Committee on Foreign Investment in the Unites States (CFIUS) is empowered to most effectively counter these threats now and in the future.
